title: Triangle Bench / Constraint Bench
claim: Compare user-entered alternatives under explicit numeric hard limits; preserve unknown/interval values, eliminate only guaranteed Pareto inferiority, and optionally find a guaranteed leader for one declared priority. Export and restore the exact local decision with rationale, next step and separately reported outcome.

predecessor.history: Predecessor calibration source remains in Git ancestry. No proof of human preference for triangle geometry is inherited.

mechanisms: 1–8 independent named quantities in native units; up to 40 entered alternatives
finite interval worst-case feasibility and robust Pareto dominance
one held option; paginated axes/options retain identity
explicit LOCAL RETURN with PROPOSED vs OBSERVATION_REPORTED distinction
numeric table fallback; no compulsory geometric vocabulary
Same-origin Omnitools source load and decision RETURN hook; the parent retains source identity and the child owns the only decision model.
known_limits: Only entered options and declared criteria are compared. Structural safety or suitability cannot be inferred from numerical fit.
Intervals are caller-declared uncertainty sets; no probabilities, correlations or inferred confidence.
A priority leader only compares complete options fitting entered limits; unresolved options remain explicitly outside that claim.
Sample measurements are synthetic and visibly labeled; no recommendation about the actual room is claimed.
Browser persistence is device-local. JSON export is necessary for cross-device durability.
Actual user use/value remains unobserved. Computational and browser proof do not establish lived usefulness.

verification.integration: Omnitools source/return bridge is exercised by tools/omnitools-smoke.mjs in the omnitools-check workflow; exact candidate results live in GitHub Actions.

authority_boundary: Local reasoning only; no CURRENT/QUEUE mutation, purchase, external sending, actuation or automatic execution.

research.transfer: mandatory criteria, alternatives, assumptions and uncertainty before choice
Pareto dominance preserves independent criteria without invented scalar utility
Declared interval worst-case feasibility; conservativeness and unknowns remain explicit
